annotations.text:
Pick a direction, don't grade the copy.

These are aesthetic arguments at low fidelity. Wording, spacing and images all get rebuilt properly once you tell me which one is you. You can also mix — e.g. C's structure with D's dark palette.

[N] and [EMAIL] are placeholders for facts I couldn't verify.

LinkedIn blocks automated reading (HTTP 999), so I built this from your Behance profile, a search snippet, and your own project folders. Paste your LinkedIn text any time and I'll replace the guesses.
